### 📊 LinkedIn Job Market Insights & BI Dashboard *(2024)*
Interactive 3-page Power BI dashboard analyzing **124,349 LinkedIn job postings** (Dec 2023 – Apr 2024) across 380 industries and 240 countries, with a Star Schema of 14 tables (2 fact, 12 dimension) built from Kaggle datasets.

**Key findings surfaced in the dashboard:**
- Remote jobs pay a **36% salary premium** ($95,000 vs $69,992 median) yet make up only 12.5% of postings — while getting 3.8x more views
- AI & Data roles command a **55% premium** ($110,000 vs $70,700) despite being just 1.65% of postings
- Salary scales **3.5x** from Entry Level ($47,840) to Executive ($168,790), with the sharpest jump (54%) between Mid-Senior and Director level
- Information Technology, Sales, and Management are the top 3 in-demand skills, covering 55%+ of all postings
- Only 29% of postings disclose salary — a market transparency gap

**Tech**: Power BI, Advanced DAX, Star Schema Data Modeling, ETL (data cleaning + outlier treatment on 124K+ records)

### 🎓 University Academic & Student Data Platform *(2024)*
Developed an end-to-end data analytics platform using Python (Pandas) and SQL, automating ETL workflows and reducing database processing errors by 95%. Built dynamic visualizations tracking student KPIs and enrollment trends, enabling data-driven academic planning and administrative decisions.

**Tech**: Python, Pandas, SQL
